text.en: Little by little, Canada took charge of its own affairs, as Australia and New Zealand did. In time, Canada could make an important contribution in the world.
text.fr: Petit à petit, le Canada a pris en main ses propres affaires, comme l'ont fait l'Australie et la Nouvelle-Zélande. Avec le temps, le Canada a pu apporter une contribution importante dans le monde.

source.quote: Like Australia, New Zealand and other countries, Canada developed its autonomy gradually with a capacity to make significant contributions internationally.

verification.evidence: Like Australia, New Zealand and other countries, Canada developed its autonomy gradually with a capacity to make significant contributions internationally.

text.en: The Cold War began when several countries in eastern Europe, just freed, became part of a Communist bloc. The Soviet Union controlled that bloc, and Josef Stalin was its dictator.
text.fr: La guerre froide a commencé lorsque plusieurs pays de l'Europe de l'Est, tout juste libérés, sont entrés dans un bloc communiste. L'Union soviétique contrôlait ce bloc, et Josef Staline en était le dictateur.

source.quote: The Cold War began when several liberated countries of eastern Europe became part of a Communist bloc controlled by the Soviet Union under the dictator Josef Stalin.

verification.evidence: The Cold War began when several liberated countries of eastern Europe became part of a Communist bloc controlled by the Soviet Union under the dictator Josef Stalin.

text.en: Canada and other democratic countries in the West formed a military alliance together. It is called the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).
text.fr: Le Canada et d'autres pays démocratiques de l'Occident ont formé ensemble une alliance militaire. Elle s'appelle l'Organisation du Traité de l'Atlantique Nord (OTAN).

source.quote: Canada joined with other democratic countries of the West to form the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), a military alliance

verification.evidence: Canada joined with other democratic countries of the West to form the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), a military alliance, and with the United States in the North American Aerospace Defence Command (NORAD).

text.en: Canada also teamed up with the United States in NORAD, the North American Aerospace Defence Command.
text.fr: Le Canada s'est aussi associé aux États-Unis au sein du NORAD, le Commandement de la défense aérospatiale de l'Amérique du Nord.

source.quote: and with the United States in the North American Aerospace Defence Command (NORAD).

verification.evidence: Canada joined with other democratic countries of the West to form the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), a military alliance, and with the United States in the North American Aerospace Defence Command (NORAD).

text.en: Canada also became a member of international bodies. The United Nations, or UN, is one of them.
text.fr: Le Canada est aussi devenu membre d'organisations internationales. L'Organisation des Nations Unies, ou ONU, en est une.

source.quote: Canada joined international organizations such as the United Nations (UN).

verification.evidence: Canada joined international organizations such as the United Nations (UN).

text.en: In the Korean War, from 1950 to 1953, Canada was part of the UN operation that defended South Korea.
text.fr: Pendant la guerre de Corée, de 1950 à 1953, le Canada a participé à l'opération de l'ONU qui défendait la Corée du Sud.

source.quote: It participated in the UN operation defending South Korea in the Korean War (1950–53)

verification.evidence: Canada joined international organizations such as the United Nations (UN). It participated in the UN operation defending South Korea in the Korean War (1950–53)

text.en: Canada has been part of many UN peacekeeping missions. They were in very different places, such as Egypt, Cyprus and Haiti.
text.fr: Le Canada a participé à de nombreuses missions de maintien de la paix de l'ONU. Elles se sont déroulées dans des endroits très différents, comme l'Égypte, Chypre et Haïti.

source.quote: Canada has taken part in numerous UN peacekeeping missions in places as varied as Egypt, Cyprus and Haiti

verification.evidence: Canada has taken part in numerous UN peacekeeping missions in places as varied as Egypt, Cyprus and Haiti
